subject: Marketplace evidence acceptance scan + DPA signoff
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Moore <dana.moore@greenfieldcloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace evidence acceptance scan + DPA signoff

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per Greenfield's marketplace onboarding checklist, I'm sending over the security/compliance artifacts we have on file so you can validate acceptance for the co-sell listing. Attached are:

- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (full report, control narratives redacted for 3rd party names)
- PenTest-Letter-Redwood-2026.pdf (summary letter from independent vendor)
- Draft DPA (we will sign and return via DocuSign once your procurement confirms the last clause)

A few quick notes:
- The SOC2 report covers our hosted API and dedicated inference control planes through 12/31/2026; the scope is listed on page 2.
- The pen test letter is a consolidated summary; vendor name and detailed finding attachments are available under NDA — we can share a scanned vendor attestation if that helps.
- If Greenfield needs a signed DPA before we share vendor artifacts, happy to route the DPA via DocuSign.

Can you confirm whether Greenfield will accept the SOC2 report + vendor pen test letter as-is or whether you need the raw findings and vendor name included in the packet? Also, do you want a one-sheet index (spreadsheet) mapping each artifact to marketplace evidence fields? We can have that back to you within 48 hours.

If it's helpful I'll loop in Legal (Kimberly) and our infra lead (Marcus) to close any gaps quickly.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (PDF), PenTest-Letter-Redwood-2026.pdf (PDF), Draft-DPA-Redwood-2027.docx (DOCX)

From: Dana Moore <dana.moore@greenfieldcloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenfieldcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace evidence acceptance scan + DPA signoff

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for sending these over. Quick clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams:

1) The pen test letter you attached doesn't list the vendor or the exact scope (external vs internal). Can you confirm the vendor name and whether the assessment included external network and web-facing API tests?
2) We typically ask for an evidence index (spreadsheet) that maps each artifact to our marketplace checklist fields (SOC2 report -> control IDs, pen test -> findings summary, DPA -> executed copy). Could you provide that index?
3) Procurement needs to confirm a DPA version; please confirm whether Redwood can sign our standard DPA (attached) or require yours. If required, we need a redline within 2 business days to keep our listing timeline.

I've attached Greenfield_RFP_security_questionnaire.xlsx — completing that will speed internal approvals. Also please include a remediation SLA statement for any critical findings discovered post-listing (we require notification within 24 hours and a mitigation plan committed within 5 business days).

If anything is covered by NDA, flag those items and we can get the NDA in place.

Best,
Dana Moore
Lead, Cloud Partnerships | Greenfield Cloud
dana.moore@greenfieldcloud.com

Attachments: Greenfield_RFP_security_questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:54:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace evidence acceptance scan + DPA signoff

Rachel / team —

Saw Dana's email. Proposed plan to satisfy Greenfield's asks:

- Action 1 (Marcus): Produce a one-sheet Marketplace_Evidence_Index mapping artifacts to Greenfield fields. Estimate: 1 business day.
- Action 2 (Kimberly): Confirm DPA posture. Either sign Greenfield's attached DPA or prepare a redline of Redwood's DPA. Target: same-day review, redline within 2 business days if needed.
- Action 3 (Aditya): Get formal pen test vendor confirmation and scope statement. We will request a short vendor attestation letter (vendor name, scope summary: external public endpoints + authenticated API) and vendor contact for validation. Target: 2 business days.
- Action 4 (Rachel): Respond to remediation SLA ask with standard process: 24h notification for critical, preliminary mitigation plan 48h, full remediation timeline within 5 business days for critical/high findings. We'll formalize this in the index.

I'll attach a draft index in my follow-up. Quoting Dana's ask below for reference:

> The pen test letter you attached doesn't list the vendor or the exact scope (external vs internal). Can you confirm the vendor name and whether the assessment included external network and web-facing API tests?
> 
> Also please include a remediation SLA statement for any critical findings discovered post-listing (we require notification within 24 hours and a mitigation plan committed within 5 business days).

Kimberly — if you need a specific risk acceptance template, say so and I'll populate with infrastructure owner signoff.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0124

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Moore <dana.moore@greenfieldcloud.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@greenfieldcloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace evidence acceptance scan + DPA signoff

Hi Dana —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per our internal runbook we've compiled the index and secured the pen test attestation. Attached are the final artifacts you requested: 

- Marketplace_Evidence_Index_20270312.xlsx (maps SOC2 controls, pen test items, DPA clauses to Greenfield fields)
- SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (redacted vendor names as discussed)
- PenTest-Letter-Redwood-2026.pdf (now includes vendor name: RedWave Security, scope: external web + API authenticated assessment; full vendor report available under NDA)

On the DPA: we signed and returned Greenfield's DPA via DocuSign. You can access the executed copy here: https://docusign.example.com/ENV/abc123-signed-dpa (link active). If procurement needs any metadata from our KMS/HSM or data residency statements, Kim is on copy to provide.

Remediation SLA: Redwood confirms the following baseline for marketplace customers: we will notify the customer and Greenfield within 24 hours of discovery of any critical production impact findings, provide a preliminary mitigation plan within 48 hours, and commit to a remediation schedule within 5 business days (exceptions will be documented with RCA timeline). We included that text in the index.

If Greenfield is comfortable accepting these artifacts for co-sell listing, please confirm and we'll mark the deal onboarding checklist item as "evidence accepted". If you need the full pen test report we can share it after an NDA — I can route that this afternoon if you'd like.

Thanks and looking forward to the green light,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Marketplace_Evidence_Index_20270312.xlsx (XLSX), SOC2-TypeII-Redwood-2026.pdf (PDF), PenTest-Letter-Redwood-2026.pdf (PDF)
